# HR Industry Definition & Boundary

| Topic | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Included | Software and services that support employee records, recruitment, onboarding, attendance, scheduling, performance, payroll, tax/social-insurance processes and HR analytics. |
| Adjacent systems | Talent marketplaces, payroll bureaus, workforce-management devices, finance systems and learning platforms may integrate with HCM but are not automatically one market. |
| Organisation boundary | Internal HR software and a public recruitment platform have different regulatory roles. A product that later provides public recruitment matching may face additional licensing and information-review obligations. |
| System boundary | Local payroll, tax, social-insurance, biometric and integration scope vary by jurisdiction, employer and implementation. |
| Geography | The evidence covers Mainland China, ASEAN/Singapore, the United States and the European Union. Employment and privacy requirements remain jurisdiction-specific. |
